_comment: Hook registration for the tracker. NOT enabled by default: copy these entries into
.claude/settings.json (or settings.local.json for just yourself) when you want a run
tracked. Architecture §7 -- the only tracking-related content permitted outside codegen/,
and it holds nothing but a matcher and a command pointing back in here.
Use $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, never a relative path. A relative path resolves against the
session's cwd, which is not the repo root whenever a command has cd'd -- the hook then
fails to start and its non-zero exit BLOCKS the tool call. Found the hard way: an earlier
relative registration broke the very session that wrote it.
